_fork_notes.why_6_1: Diverges from spec v6.0 in five places, each traced to a review finding. See docs/DELTAS-FROM-SPEC-V6.md.
changes: eliminates edges MUST carry non-empty requires (kills the elimination-sweep dominant strategy)
new edge type: eliminates_by_conjunction (>=2 evidence inputs, no single clearing card)
new node fields: tier / unlock_action (Investigation Clock)
new node field: reads_as (what the document literally prints, vs. the deduction it licenses)
tier bands measured against the BASE dossier only; action-gated nodes are earned, not counted

canonical_incident.victim_role: Head of Conservation, Meridian Fine Art Storage & Conservation
canonical_incident.location: Cold Store 3, Vault Level B2, Meridian Fine Art Storage, Aldenmoor
canonical_incident.cause_of_death: Hypoxic asphyxia (oxygen-reduction fire-suppression discharge, O2 to 9.4%)
canonical_incident.manner: Homicide, staged as sudden cardiac collapse

forensic_model.algor_mortis_rule: Cooling rate is proportional to the body-ambient differential. rate(A) = 0.9 * (37 - A) / (37 - 21)
forensic_model.player_math: 5.0 hr (ME) divided by 1.94 = 2.6 hr. Single division. Table-solvable with a pencil.

canonical_suspects.name: Vivienne Marchetti
canonical_suspects.motive_category: Concealment of asset theft / financial ruin
canonical_suspects.motive_detail: Sold four original Halvorsen albumen plates by private treaty for $412,000 over 14 months, substituting modern reproductions. Renn's audit found the substitution.
canonical_suspects.apparent_status_before_reframe: CLEARED - airtight alibi for the stated TOD window
canonical_suspects.apparent_status_after_reframe: The only suspect with no alibi for the true window
canonical_suspects.descriptor_block: female, early 50s, tall, silver bob cut blunt at the jaw, heavy tortoiseshell frames, charcoal wool suit, single strand of pearls

canonical_suspects.name: Oskar Pryce
canonical_suspects.suspicious_factor: One of only two Level-4 suppression-override credential holders. Skipped the 22:00 B2 round and back-dated the handwritten log. Found the body and delayed the emergency call by 14 minutes. Documented grievance: Renn's incident report cost him his overtime allocation.
canonical_suspects.real_secret: Asleep off-post in the Level D loading bay office. Falsified the round log to hide it. Misconduct, not murder.
canonical_suspects.descriptor_block: male, mid 40s, heavy build, shaved head, grey uniform sweater with Meridian shoulder flash, thick steel wristwatch

canonical_suspects.name: Dr. Lena Kovaleski
canonical_suspects.suspicious_factor: Alone in B2 with the victim for over three hours. Passed over for Renn's post eighteen months ago. Lied in her first statement - said she left at 19:45; her badge says 21:26.
canonical_suspects.real_secret: Using Meridian's solvent store and vacuum table after hours for a private restoration commission. Contract breach, not murder.
canonical_suspects.elimination_gate: Her exit at 21:26 clears her ONLY against the corrected window. Against the stated window (19:10-20:10) she is the strongest suspect in the building.
canonical_suspects.descriptor_block: female, late 30s, small frame, dark hair pinned up, nitrile gloves, magnifying visor pushed to forehead, blue conservation smock

canonical_suspects.name: Danny Ferraro
canonical_suspects.job: Freight and handling contractor, Ostrand Logistics
canonical_suspects.suspicious_factor: His crew moved the Halvorsen crates in January. Prior dismissal for warehouse theft. His signature is on the crate manifest carrying the discrepancy.
canonical_suspects.design_purpose: The tutorial elimination. Cleared cheaply and early so the group learns the mechanic and banks one win before the hard work starts.
canonical_suspects.descriptor_block: male, late 20s, wiry, buzzcut, high-vis vest over a hooded sweatshirt, forearm tattoo of a ship's anchor

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Autopsy: no trauma, no ligature, no occlusion. Findings consistent with acute hypoxic asphyxia. Provisional manner: ACCIDENTAL. Contributory: documented cardiopulmonary insufficiency; decedent held a standing medical exemption barring extended entry to reduced-oxygen zones. Cold Store 3 is maintained at a nominal 15.0% oxygen under the facility's fire-prevention protocol.
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: The case OPENS as an accident. The staged reading is: a man with a heart condition entered a low-oxygen room he was barred from. Every piece of the real case has to be dug out from under that.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Liver temperature 32.5 C recorded 00:41. Methodology block: 'Ambient at scene 20.8 C per responding officer intake form. Standard cooling constant 0.9 C/hr applied.' Estimated TOD 19:41, window 19:10-20:10.
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: The ambient value is printed in a boilerplate methodology line, not in the findings. The ME did correct arithmetic on a wrong input.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: First responder narrative: body relocated from Cold Store 3 to the B2 corridor at 00:11 to attempt resuscitation in breathable atmosphere. Ambient temperature recorded 00:29: 20.8 C. Location of reading: B2 corridor.
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: DOOR B. The ambient the ME used was measured in the wrong room, eighteen minutes after the body left the right one.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Vault climate log, Cold Store 3: 6.0 C +/- 0.2, continuous, 14:00 Thu through 00:11 Fri. Setpoint mandated by the Halvorsen loan agreement for albumen prints.
Conservation server write log: HALVORSEN_DISCREPANCY_v4.docx, 21:51:07, user t.renn, workstation B2-CONS-02.
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: DOOR A. Proves the stated window is wrong without explaining why. Gives a floor, not a window.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Life-safety system status page, Zone B2-CS3. Nominal oxygen setpoint 15.0%. Interlock: ACTIVE. Discrete events logged this reporting period: 2. Detail: see full event log (not included in this extract).
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: THE SIGNPOST. A bare event count on a status page. Meaningless until you know the death happened at 22:06 rather than 19:41 - at which point 'two events' becomes the most interesting number in the dossier.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Suppression system credential roster. Level-4 manual override: 2 holders. V. Marchetti (Director). O. Pryce (Night Security Supervisor). No other active credentials.
B2 access log: L.KOVALESKI OUT 21:26:44. Lobby camera still, 21:33. Transit card validation, Kestrel Row Station (6.2 km), 21:35.
Ostrand Logistics run sheet: D. Ferraro, Aldenmoor-Brenholt ferry crossing, vehicle manifest and fuel card transactions, 17:40 Thu to 01:20 Fri, 190 km from the facility.

Full life-safety event log, Zone B2-CS3. 21:58:41 MANUAL DISCHARGE, initiated at corridor panel B2-P1, credential level 4, occupancy interlock OVERRIDDEN BY OPERATOR. O2 15.0% to 9.4% by 22:06. 22:20:13 MANUAL VENT, panel B2-P1, same credential level.
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: Two deliberate manual acts twenty-two minutes apart at a physical corridor panel, with the occupancy interlock overridden by hand. This is the line that converts an accident into a homicide. It is action-gated precisely because it also timestamps the death - free access to it would let players skip the entire reframe.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Level D service door and freight elevator log: V.MARCHETTI IN 21:32:18, OUT 22:34:51. Freight elevator cycles D to B2 at 21:35, B2 to D at 22:31.
canonical_evidence_nodes.signpost: The BASE B2 access log prints two freight-elevator door cycles at 21:35 and 22:31 with no matching B2 badge event. The anomaly is visible for free; the answer costs an action.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Perrin Foundation dinner corroboration packet: last photograph including Marchetti timestamped 20:16. Her table's terminal receipt settled 20:20. Seating steward: 'I could not say when she left. It was a floating room.'
canonical_evidence_nodes.signpost: Her statement (C-1) claims she stayed until 22:15. The base dossier records that claim; nothing in the base dossier tests it.

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Raw guard-tour NFC data (unedited): O.PRYCE, Checkpoint 7, Level D loading bay, 21:44:11 and 22:02:37. Stairwell B2-ST1 door alarm log: no activation 17:30 Thu to 00:07 Fri.
canonical_evidence_nodes.design_note: Does not clear him alone. Only in conjunction with EV-06 (discharge at 21:58 from the B2 corridor panel, i.e. between his two scans) and EV-08 (the only two freight-elevator cycles both belong to Marchetti).

canonical_evidence_nodes.reads_as: Three private-treaty settlement wires to a numbered account, $412,000 total, dated across 14 months, cross-matched to four Halvorsen accession numbers flagged in the victim's audit file.
canonical_evidence_nodes.signpost: The base dossier prints the filename the victim saved at 21:51: HALVORSEN_DISCREPANCY_v4.docx. A discrepancy in a collection is a thing somebody profits from. The word is the pointer; following the money costs an action.

canonical_dag_edges.note: THE REFRAME. Three-input conjunction. Nothing downstream is reachable without it.
Gated on the reframe by design. Before you know he died at 22:06, an event count on a status page is furniture.
Overturns the provisional ACCIDENTAL finding in EV-01.

tier_measurement.conformance: PASS on suspects, base-dossier nodes, red herrings, cross-suspect edges. FAIL on max_depth (10 vs 2). See DELTAS finding #3 - the spec's depth bands cannot express a case containing a reframe, and the five tier dimensions do not co-vary, so one label cannot bound them all.
tier_measurement.deviation_rationale: Spec v6.0 bands MEDIUM at depth 2, which describes a case with no reframe: establish two facts, accuse. Our keystone (corrected time of death) sits four inferences deep before any suspect is touched. Declared, not silently tolerated. See DELTAS finding #3.

investigation_actions.budget_rule: 6 actions for 1-2 detectives, 7 for 3-4, 8 for 5-6. Actions do not regenerate. The final accusation is free.
investigation_actions._note: Minimum winning set is 4 of a 11-card deck; clean sweep is 5. A 6-action group has two spare. Draft numbers - the first playtest measures whether that slack is too kind.

deck.label: Pull the full life-safety event log for Zone B2-CS3
Pull Level D service-door and freight elevator logs
Request raw guard-tour NFC data (bypassing the handwritten log)
Pull Kestrel Row transit and platform camera

investigation_actions.gating_order: ACT-11 is not usefully spendable until the group has corrected the time of death from the base dossier alone. A group that buys it first learns the mechanism but cannot yet place anyone at the panel.

ground_truth_timeline.event: Facility closes to day staff. Night complement: Pryce, Kovaleski.
Kovaleski badges into B2.
Renn badges into B2 to continue the Halvorsen condition audit.
Renn messages Marchetti: 'Found the problem with Halvorsen. I am in B2 tonight. This cannot wait.'
Marchetti arrives at the Perrin Foundation dinner, Aldenmoor Athenaeum, 22 km away.
Last photograph including Marchetti.
Her table's terminal receipt is settled. She leaves shortly after, unobserved, from a forty-guest floating room.
Kovaleski badges out of B2.
Marchetti badges the Level D service door. Not the lobby.
Freight elevator cycles D to B2.
Pryce scans Checkpoint 7, Level D loading bay. He is off-post and about to fall asleep.
Renn saves HALVORSEN_DISCREPANCY_v4.docx to the conservation server. Marchetti does not know this file exists.
Marchetti confronts Renn in Cold Store 3, then steps into the corridor and seals the door.
Manual hypoxic discharge from corridor panel B2-P1, Level-4 credential, occupancy interlock overridden.
Pryce's scheduled B2 round. NOT PERFORMED. The handwritten log will later say otherwise.
Pryce scans Checkpoint 7 again, still Level D.
O2 reaches 9.4%. Renn dies. TRUE TIME OF DEATH.
Manual vent from panel B2-P1. Marchetti re-enters, takes Renn's tablet, leaves the body.
Freight elevator cycles B2 to D.
Marchetti badges out of the Level D service door.
Pryce begins his late round.
Body found in Cold Store 3.
Emergency call placed. Fourteen minutes after discovery; Pryce spent them back-dating the round log.
First responders arrive.
Body relocated to the B2 corridor for resuscitation attempt.
Responding officer records ambient 20.8 C. In the corridor. This number will poison the autopsy.
Deputy ME records liver temperature 32.5 C.

solution_shape.one_line: The time of death is wrong, and everything you believe about who had an alibi is downstream of it.
solution_shape.inversion: Before the reframe: Marchetti is the only cleared suspect and everyone else looks guilty. After the reframe: everyone else is cleared and Marchetti is the only one without an alibi. The suspect list flips whole.
solution_shape.the_killers_mistake: She took the tablet. The file was already on the server.
